candidates.explanation: The access-token strategy verifies tokens with 'auth.refreshSecret', but access tokens are signed in AuthService.getTokensData with 'auth.secret'. The signature check therefore always fails, so every request with a fresh access token gets 401. Login and refresh still work because the refresh strategy and signing use the correct secrets.

fix.description: Use the access token secret ('auth.secret') in secretOrKey instead of 'auth.refreshSecret'.

candidates.explanation: The access-token strategy verifies tokens with 'auth.refreshSecret', but access tokens are signed in AuthService.getTokensData with 'auth.secret'. The signature check therefore always fails, so every request with a fresh access token gets 401. Login and refresh still work because the refresh strategy and signing use the correct secrets.

fix.description: Use the access token secret ('auth.secret') in secretOrKey instead of 'auth.refreshSecret'.
